newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain CPI may pick up, April data very good.
newsitem.headline: Spain CPI may pick up, April data very good.

text.p: Spanish Economy Ministry Rodrigo Rato said on Wednesday that the April Consumer Price Index (CPI), which rose 1.7 percent year on year, was "extraordinarily positive" although the CPI may rise to about two percent.
"It's more than possible that there will be a recovery in prices to around two percent in the next few months," Rato told a press conference.
Rato said the government may revise down its 1997 inflation target, which now stands at 2.6 percent. But he refused to specify any range for such a revision.
The improvement in the CPI was not a coincidence, he said.
"These data did not came by chance, but are the result of a series of efforts made in the latest months," he added.
